mechanism: Brimonidine is an alpha-2 adrenergic agonist that can cause hyperkalemia through reduced cellular potassium uptake and decreased renal potassium excretion, particularly with systemic absorption or in patients with renal impairment.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels in patients on potassium supplementation or with renal dysfunction receiving brimonidine; consider alternative alpha-2 agonists if hyperkalemia develops.
